fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-07-18 (afternoon, 16:10): An unidentified customer allegedly took cosmetic products worth Rs. 40,000 from Kavin Textiles near Vaigai Layout Market Road in Tiruppur. Saravanan Palanisamy approached Tiruppur North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000235. The complainant is associated with the business Kavin Textiles. The complaint mentions Anand Palanisamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000093, in connection with the events. A witness, Dharani Anand, reachable on 9000000114, was mentioned in the complaint. Dinesh Balan (9000000363), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned physical documents and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Missing stock noticed at closing time and a review of shop CCTV was requested.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, documents, afternoon, witness, suspect, CCTV, associate
